title: fix(plugin-detail): a refused related-list row delete toasts its refusal
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBTDAJKyXUan6fJCKsZUf5Pv)_

Fixes #36851

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户在记录页的相关列表里删除一行、被服务器拒绝时(例如订单已确认、订单行被锁定),以前什么提示都没有,现在会弹出「删除 订单行 失败」并附上服务器给出的原因,和对象列表页的提示一致。
- 解决记录页相关列表「删除被拒却毫无反馈」的体验缺陷,替所有遇到业务锁定或钩子拒绝删除的用户补上提示。
- 出错最多是提示文字不理想或多弹一次提示,数据不受影响,可以直接撤回本次改动。
- 无

## What changes

`RelatedList`'s row delete (`handleConfirmDelete`) caught a rejected delete and only `console.error`ed it, so a refused delete (a hook, a record lock answering `409 RECORD_LOCKED` with a `userMessage`) closed the dialog with nothing on screen. It now toasts the refusal through the same surface and words the object's list page uses for the same refusal (`recordDelete` in `@object-ui/core`): `toast.error(t('objectActions.deleteFailed', { label }), { description })`, where the description is

1. the producer-marked `userMessage` (`declaredUserMessage`, verbatim) when the refusal carries one;
2. the read-only sentence (`form.readOnlyExternalSource`) for an external datasource refusal (ADR-0015), as the list page does;
3. otherwise the server's sentence with its machine prefix stripped (`extractWriteErrorMessage`); with no sentence at all, the title alone.

Decisions:

- **Dialog closes, as today.** The list page's delete closes its confirm and toasts; the related list's refused edit happens inside the host's form, which is not a confirm dialog, so there is no "stays open with the error" precedent to follow for a delete. The row stays (no refresh on failure, unchanged).
- **Secondary (hide Edit/Delete on a `RECORD_LOCKED` row): left out.** Not trivially free: the client has no per-row lock verdict before the server answers; deciding it would need a new row-level signal, outside this file.
- `useObjectLabel()` moved up a few lines (above the callback that now reads it); the bulk-delete outcome reads the same binding as before.

Files: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`, its existing delete harness `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.deleteConfirmNamed-13333.test.tsx` (new top-level `describe`), one patch changeset.

Read first: the `handleConfirmDelete` hunk in `RelatedList.tsx` (the only behaviour change).

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.deleteConfirmNamed-13333.test.tsx` → `Tests 10 passed (10)`.

## Tests

New pins (top-level `describe` in the existing delete harness), at `8c5175050`:

- a refusal carrying a `userMessage` toasts it under `Failed to delete Order Line`;
- a refusal with no `userMessage` toasts the cleaned server sentence;
- a refusal with no sentence toasts the title alone;
- CONTROL: a successful delete toasts no error.

## Acceptance notes

- Browser reach: NOT MEASURED, reason: no shipped example object refuses a delete from a hook or a record lock, so a browser repro needs fixture metadata authored for it; the jsdom pin drives the same rejected-promise path the host's delete produces.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on `RelatedList.tsx` reports one pre-existing error at the `ActionIcon` render (line ~532, an inline-disabled `react-hooks/static-components`), present on main; nothing on the changed lines.
